title: Easy Hennessy Pineapple Cocktail Recipe You’ll Love This Summer
description: The Hennessy Pineapple Cocktail is a bold yet refreshing mix of smooth cognac and tropical pineapple juice. It blends the warmth of Hennessy with the bright, tangy sweetness of pineapple for a perfectly balanced sip. Simple to make, it’s ideal for summer gatherings or unwinding on a weekend. With just a few ingredients, it delivers a punch of flavor and elegance in every glass.
author: Better Sweet Drinks
ingredients: Smooth and bold with notes of oak and spice; VS for easy sipping, VSOP for deeper flavor.
Brings tropical sweetness and acidity; use fresh or cold-pressed juice for best taste.
Add only if your juice isn’t sweet enough; balance the drink without overpowering it.
Essential for chilling and slightly diluting; use large cubes for slow melt, crushed for extra chill.
Adds aroma and visual appeal; turns a basic drink into something Instagram-worthy.
instructions:
Fill your cocktail shaker with ice

Use plenty of ice—it chills the drink fast and adds just the right amount of dilution for a smooth sip.

Add 2 oz of Hennessy and 4 oz of pineapple juice

Pour with intention. This is where the bold and the bright come together.

Add 0.5 oz of simple syrup (optional)

Taste your pineapple juice first. If it’s not sweet enough, this little touch rounds things out.

Shake it like you mean it—for about 10 seconds

You want the shaker cold to the touch. That’s how you know it’s mixed and chilled perfectly.

Strain into a rocks glass filled with fresh ice

Don’t reuse the shaker ice—fresh cubes keep it crisp and clean.

Garnish with a pineapple wedge

It’s not just for looks. A good garnish adds aroma and makes your cocktail feel complete.

 Serve immediately and enjoy
notes:
• Use fresh pineapple juice for the best flavor.
  • Shake with crushed ice for a colder, frothier drink.
  • Don’t skip the garnish, it adds aroma and style.
